text:
maria: Morning — quick async check-in. What I did: triaged last-night SLO spike (502s on /generate), updated the runbook with an initial hypothesis (redis connection retries), and opened two small PRs. Blockers: still noisy alerts for redis-timeout; paging at 3am hit oncall. Today: finish alert tuning PR, hand off oncall notes, and review tomas' batching change.

aj: saw the spike — looks like a surge of short-lived connections causing connection pool exhaustion. I dumped the pool metrics to /tmp/pool-metrics.log and pushed to the incident thread. Will drop a focused metric to measure active connections by client_ip.

tomas: thanks — pinged you on the batching PR (small change to N=16 -> N=8 default). CI green but need a perf run on staging. If batching reduces tail latency we should keep.

samir: FYI I muted the noisy redis-timeout alert for 30m while we validate tuning; created ticket SRE-482 to track follow-ups (alerts + runbook completeness).

oncall-bot: Pager routed to aj at 2026-03-11T03:12:07Z — alert: redis-timeout threshold breached (count>5 in 5m).

maria: samir — can you add a step in the runbook to check conn_pool_size + ephemeral port exhaustion? I added a draft but want your ops steps. Link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/redis-timeouts.md

aj: will add conn_pool step. Also adding a Prom rule suggestion to reduce noise:

```yaml
- alert: HighRedisClientTimeouts
  expr: increase(redis_client_timeout_total[5m]) > 3
  for: 2m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "redis client timeouts increased"
```

maria: that looks good — maybe bump `for` to 5m to avoid flapping.

tomas: I can run a quick staging perf with batching=8 and the new pooling config later today (ETA 14:00 PST). Will post results.

samir: PR for alert tuning is https://git.redwood/sre/alerts/pull/77 — added unit-test for the rule and a comment explaining rationale. Please review.

aj: reviewing now. Also a heads-up: deploy-bot reported a minor rollback yesterday on dedicated pool, not related to this, but left a note in eng-runtime.

deploy-bot: Deploy completed: release/2026-03-10. Rollback detected on service=gpu-proxy; reason=OOM in canary.

maria: OK — plan for today: aj adds conn_pool + rule tweak, samir merges alert PR after review, tomas runs staging perf, I'll finalize runbook and handoff notes for the night shift. If anyone is OOO, call it out.

aj: on it. Will post when rule is staged. :thumbsup:

tomas: will update with perf numbers.

samir: merging after aj sign-off.

maria: thanks — sending a short summary to #incidents after we close the loop.
